description: This file defines the 'hour' unit for a date/time library, including formatting tokens, parsing rules, locale handling, and getter/setter functions for hours.

methods.name: hFormat
methods.description: Returns the hour in 12-hour format, with 12 instead of 0.

methods.name: kFormat
methods.description: Returns the hour in 24-hour format, with 24 instead of 0.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Defines format tokens for meridiem (AM/PM) based on locale.

methods.name: localeIsPM
methods.description: Determines if the input string indicates PM in the locale.

methods.name: localeMeridiem
methods.description: Returns 'AM' or 'PM' based on the hour and locale preferences.
